item.title: Portion of North Escambia Is Officially In A Moderate Drought
item.description: A large swath of the North Escambia area is in a moderate drought, according to the U.S. Drought Monitor. While rain is on tap for Saturday, only a half inch or less is expected across the area. The drought area includes McDavid, Walnut Hill, Bratt and Century.
